knowledge_specs:
MuscleBlaze BCAA Gold is a breakthrough intra-workout fuel with an 8:1:1 ratio of branched chain amino acids including Leucine, Isoleucine, and Valine respectively. The common BCAA ratio found in regular intra-workout supplements is 2:1:1 with 2 parts of leucine over 1 part each for the other two BCAAs. A higher leucine content in your intra-workout fuel may prove a game changer as it activates the complex muscle building pathways when body undergoes a heavy-duty workout. It enhances the synthesis of protein in the muscles thus helping in lean mass gain and faster recovery. 
 
Benefits
1.8:1:1 BCAAs
MuscleBlaze BCAA Gold contains an 8:1:1 ratio of BCAAs with 8 parts of Leucine and 1 part each of isoleucine and valine respectively. Most common BCAAs available in the market contain a common ratio of 2:1:1 for Leucine, isoleucine, and valine. The superior ratio of 8:1:1 makes MuscleBlaze BCAA Gold more effective
 
2.Higher Leucine Content
MuscleBlaze® BCAA Gold is a superior intra-workout fuel due to its higher leucine content with 5.6g of leucine per serving having an 8:1:1 ratio with Isoleucine and Valine respectively. Leucine is one of the major activators of a complex called mTOR, which ramps up muscle protein synthesis and therefore muscle growth.
 
3.Electrolytes
BCAA Gold has sodium and potassium as potent electrolytes. When consumed during the workouts, these electrolytes help keep the vital electrolytes in the body and prevent the onset of fatigue. These electrolytes also help in hydrating the body during strenuous workouts.
 
4.Faster Recovery
Glutamine is found as over 61% of amino acid in the skeletal muscles and contains 19% of the nitrogen responsible for the vasodilation of nerves. With 2.5g of L-Glutamine, BCAA Gold provides ample amino acids for faster muscle growth and recovery of skeletal muscles which wear and tear during workout.
 
5.Max Pump
Each serving of BCAA Gold is loaded with L-Citrulline which facilitates vasodilation and pump. It acts a potent precursor to arginine which enhances the transportation of nutrients to the muscles by increased blood flow to the muscles.
 
6.No added Sugar
We deliver only what is best for you thus MuscleBlaze® BCAA Gold is completely free from added sugar to help you gulp down only what is good.
 
Ingredients
Branched chain Amino Acid (L- Leucine, L- Iso leucine, L- Valine), L- Glutamine, L - Citrulline DL - Malate, Trisodium Citrate Anhydrous, Citric Acid, Potassium Chloride, Sodium Chloride, Orange Fruit Powder & Vitamin B6
